thread:
Mohit (Product): Heads-up — billing schema change going out. Goal: make short, high-throughput bursts and promo credit rollforwards visible and predictable on invoices. Plan to launch beta next week, full roll on 2026-04-15 for new invoices.

Carla (Finance): Quick question — is this a cosmetic label change or does it move revenue recognition lines?

Mohit (Product): It's a structural change: invoices will gain a dedicated 'burst_bucket_minutes' line and a compact 'credit_rollforward' block. Revenue recognition stays the same; we just expose the accounting for burst minutes separately so customers can see minute-level burst charges.

Ajay (Eng): Does enforcement of quotas change? Are we switching to minute-bucket throttles?

Mohit (Product): No change to request-level rate limits. We are adding a parallel accounting layer that tracks consumed burst minutes per billing window. Enforcement for rate limits remains in the runtime, separate from billing.

Tim (Customer Success): How will promo credits expire now? Customers always ask.

Mohit (Product): Promo credits issued after rollout auto-rollforward for 90 days (up from immediate month-end expiry). Invoices will show a single rollforward line with remaining days. Existing credits keep current expiry.

Carla (Finance): Any impact to overage policy or grace windows?

Mohit (Product): We're shortening the automatic spike grace window from 48h to 24h for hosted accounts to reduce surprise liabilities. Dedicated/Enterprise customers keep contract terms. New trial accounts get a one-time "first-month spike" waiver applied programmatically.

billing-bot: Migration job created: billing-migrate-v2-1835 queued. Preview for 1k accounts in ~30m. Logs: /internal/billing/logs/1835.

Ajay (Eng): SDKs parse invoice responses; will we add a version header?

Mohit (Product): Yes — responses will include X-Redwood-Invoice-Version. SDKs should parse by key, not field order. We'll publish snippet in docs and provide sample JSON.

Mohit (Product): Sample snippet for engineers:
```json
{
  "invoice_id": "inv_7a9f",
  "lines": [
    {"code": "usage_tokens", "description": "text generation tokens", "amount": "240.00"},
    {"code": "burst_bucket_minutes", "description": "minute-bursts (pool: shared)", "minutes": "8", "amount": "4.80"}
  ],
  "credits": {"applied": "15.00", "rollforward_window_days": "90"}
}
```

Tim (Customer Success): I'll prepare the in-console banner + customer email. Can finance sign-off sample text?

Carla (Finance): I will review the sample wording. Make sure the invoice example clearly shows the rollforward window.

Ops (Platform): We'll run a staged rollout: beta flag -> 5% -> 50% -> full. Scheduling migration during low-traffic window. Posting timeline to #release-war-room.

Mohit (Product): Action items:
- Tim: customer comms + banner (48h)
- Ajay: SDK compatibility + tests (72h)
- Carla: invoice language + accounting review (24h)
- Ops: migration plan + canary (ETA next Tue)

Mohit (Product): Note: please do not hardcode field positions in parsers. If you spot any legal/accounting flags, loop Carla in. :memo:
